description: This file defines a Java class UpdateLoanOfficerCommandHandler that handles commands to update the loan officer associated with a loan in the Fineract platform. It implements processing logic by invoking a service method to perform loan reassignment.

classes.name: UpdateLoanOfficerCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to update the loan officer associated with a loan, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to update the loan officer by delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService to perform loan reassignment.
